name: AWS Europe (Ireland) region eu-west-1 + Dublin facilities
developer: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Data Services Ireland Ltd)
notes: AWS eu-west-1 Ireland region with 3 AZs (official region docs A). Physical Dublin-area facilities (Clonshaugh, Tallaght, Mulhuddart, Ballycoolin) operated by Amazon Data Services Ireland Ltd; region-level record, exact facility addresses not disclosed. capacity_mw null.

name: AWS Drogheda (Premier Periclase site)
developer: Premier Periclase Ltd (Amazon Data Services Ireland linked)
notes: Premier Periclase, Strand Road/Boyne Avenue, Drogheda, Co. Louth: Louth County Council granted conditional planning permission Jun 2025 for phase 1 including a 32MW data centre (26,550 sqm three-storey DC + energy centre); An Taisce appeal lodged, under consideration. Status approved-under-appeal; capacity_mw 32 per Drogheda Life phase-1.

name: AWS Dublin Cruiserath campus (northwest Dublin)
notes: Trio of planned data centers on Cruiserath Road, northwest Dublin (Fingal/Dublin): local councillors granted planning permission Jul 2025; appeal against decision lodged by opponents, ongoing (DCD B). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Azure North Europe / Grange Castle
notes: Azure North Europe region = Ireland (official region list A). Physical campus at Grange Castle, South Dublin (operational, multiple buildings); building-level planning tracked via South Dublin County Council. capacity_mw null.

name: Google Dublin / Grange Castle
notes: Google data-centre presence in Ireland (Grange Castle, South Dublin; Profile Park/Clonshaugh) per official Google locations page (A for presence). 2024 application for new Grange Castle DC refused by SDCC (B per methodology/Silicon Republic). No GCP Ireland public region on official list.

name: Meta Clonee
notes: Meta owned data-centre campus at Clonee, Co. Meath (official Meta locations page A); operational; not a public cloud region. capacity_mw null.

name: Digital Realty Dublin portfolio (DUB sites)
notes: Digital Realty/Interxion Dublin portfolio: multiple DUB facilities across Blanchardstown, Clonshaugh/Profile Park, Grange Castle (e.g. DUB10 at Blanchardstown Corporate Park, Ballycoolin ~10MW per directory). Operator page A for marketed sites; per-site capacity/status needs planning/EPA corroboration.

name: Equinix Dublin portfolio (DB1-DB8)
notes: Equinix Dublin IBX portfolio DB1-DB8 (official page A); DB7x/DB8 expansions tracked via planning records; major Dublin colo/IX anchor with INEX. capacity_mw null (aggregate portfolio).

name: CyrusOne Dublin I (DUB1)
notes: CyrusOne DUB1, Grange Castle Business Park South, Dublin (South Dublin): groundbreaking Sep 2019, first phase (12MW) live 2021, campus designed for 74MW across 3 buildings/33,445 sqm; 2023 extension application (32,419 sqm) refused Sep 2023. Operator page A for campus; 74MW full-build B.

name: Pure DC Dublin (Ballycoolin)
notes: Pure DC Dublin campus at Ballycoolin/Orion Business Park (Fingal), official page A; power/microgrid claims require official corroboration. capacity_mw null.

name: Echelon DUB20 Arklow
notes: Echelon DUB20 at Arklow, Co. Wicklow (Avoca River Park): 100MW/45,000 sqm campus planning granted; phase 2 granted late 2025 (with EUR2.67M council levy); EUR855M debt financing to complete four Irish DCs; biogas co-location for backup power. Under construction (B: Silicon Republic, Independent, DCD).

name: Vantage Dublin (DUB1)
notes: Vantage entered Irish market Apr 2024 with multi-phase DUB1 campus, EUR1bn+ investment; first location at New Nangor Road, Dublin lost planning appeal to ABP in Apr 2025 (bebeez B) - location/planning refs pending. Status planned with setback; do not count as active until confirmed site.

name: Herbata Naas campus (M7, Kildare)
notes: Herbata Ltd campus adjacent M7/Naas business park, Co. Kildare (ref 24/60787): six two-storey data-centre buildings, EUR3bn, Kildare CC granted 20 Aug 2025 (A decision per methodology); appeals to An Coimisiun Pleanala lodged 16 Sep 2025 by FIE/ClientEarth observation - stalled under appeal. Status approved-under-appeal (B).

name: Red Admiral DC / Rochfortbridge (Lumcloon)
developer: Red Admiral DC Ltd (Lumcloon Energy Group)
notes: Red Admiral DC Ltd, six-unit data centre + decentralised energy/solar on 600-acre site between Tyrrellspass and Rochfortbridge, Co. Westmeath; Westmeath CC approved 2 Jun 2025; ACP ruled May 2025 not SID; 250MW campus reported; Jul 2026 reports say council stalled project (TheJournal). Status approved/stalled - B.

name: Art Data Centres Ennis
notes: Art Data Centres campus at Tulla Rd/M18, Ennis, Co. Clare: planning granted 2022, ABP approved Apr 2024 (six data halls, 1.3m sq ft, EUR1.2-1.6bn); judicial review dismissed; works to start Mar 2026 per RTE. Status construction-start (B). Capacity not officially disclosed.

name: CIX Cork Internet Exchange (Hollyhill)
notes: CIX carrier-neutral colo/IXP at Hollyhill Industrial Estate, Cork: operational since 2008, EUR6m expansion doubled facility; INEX Cork peering anchor. cix.ie official A; ~4MW per directory (C). Regional colo/IXP rather than hyperscale.

name: Mayo Data Hub / Killala (AVAIO)
notes: Mayo Data Hub Ltd application (24/60390) for data centre at Tawnaghmore Upper/Mullaferry, Killala, Co. Mayo: ~29,000 sqm, ~50MW average electrical power; Mayo CC granted planning (AVAIO announcement); appeal lodged to An Coimisiun Pleanala (case PL16.320786) - on hold. Status approved-under-appeal (B; ACP case page A).

name: Apple Athenry (historical)
notes: Apple's planned data centre at Derrydonnell, Athenry, Co. Galway (Connacht): planning granted 2015, appealed, project abandoned/cancelled 2018 after years of litigation; historical marker only, not counted as active facility (per IE methodology).
